# Outcheck / 나갔어체크

> A one-tap "did I lock / turn off / close it?" checklist for leaving home.
> Door, gas, garage by default, plus any custom items. A tap stamps today's time
> on the row; the whole list clears at local midnight.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://outcheck.try-dabble.com/
The item list and today's checks stay in this browser on this device. No accounts,
no uploads, no server storage, no ads, no in-app purchases, no cap on items.

This is NOT a chore-history app and NOT a smart-lock controller. It does not
talk to any lock, sensor or hub. It is a confirmation you make with your thumb
on the way out, and it forgets yesterday at midnight so old checks never blur
into today's.

## Pages

- [Home](https://outcheck.try-dabble.com/): The leave-home checklist
- [Privacy](https://outcheck.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/outcheck): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Three starter rows: Door locked, Gas off, Garage closed (labels editable)
- One big tap target per row: tap to check with a timestamp, tap again to uncheck
- Short vibration on check where the device supports it, silent otherwise
- Resets at local midnight, also while the tab stays open
- Add, rename, reorder and remove custom items with no limit
- Calm "all clear" band when every row is checked
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
